## Fixed

- **The review gate was silently discarded when `/readyset` ran under omp's RPC host.** Readyset
  opened its review overlay whenever `ctx.ui.custom` existed. omp's RPC mode defines it only as a
  stub that resolves `undefined` immediately ("Custom UI not supported in RPC mode"), which
  Readyset treated as Esc (Discard). Over RPC (editor integrations, orchestrators, benchmark
  harnesses), `/readyset` therefore wrote the proposal, design, specs and tasks, then stopped
  without asking for approval or executing anything.

  The overlay is now used only when `ctx.mode === "tui"` (omp's own documented guard for custom
  components; older builds without `mode` were TUI-only and keep the overlay). Every other host
  gets the classic review menu via `ctx.ui.select`, which RPC forwards to the client like any
  other picker. Interactive TUI behaviour is unchanged.

  Found by driving `/readyset` headless against omp 18.2.0; a new test stubs `ui.custom` exactly
  as the RPC host does and asserts the classic gate is shown.
